requirements.value: Applicant must hold a corresponding valid and unrestricted license in another US jurisdiction, possess substantially similar qualifications, have no prior discipline, no civil/criminal malpractice liability, no suspended or revoked license, no pending disciplinary action, pay applicable fees, and submit fingerprints for background check.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety due to illness, mental/physical condition, or substance use
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of illness, a mental or physical condition or the use of alcohol, drugs, narcotics or any other substance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct intended to deceive or violating standards of practice or pharmacy regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any conduct: (1) Which is intended to deceive; (2) Which the Board has determined is a violation of the standards of practice established by regulation of the Board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Administering, dispensing, or prescribing controlled substances or dangerous drugs to self or others except as authorized by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Administering, dispensing or prescribing any controlled substance, or any dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS, to or for himself or herself or to others except as authorized by law.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law, or performing services the licensee is not competent to perform
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing or offering to practice beyond the scope permitted by law or performing services which the licensee knows or has reason to know that he or she is not competent to perform or which are beyond the scope of his or her training.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performing experimental procedures or prescribing experimental therapy without obtaining informed consent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performing, without first obtaining the informed consent of the patient or the patient's family, any procedure or prescribing any therapy which by the current standards of the practice of medicine is experimental.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence ordinarily exercised by physicians in the same specialty
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Continual failure to exercise the skill or diligence or use the methods ordinarily exercised under the same circumstances by physicians in good standing practicing in the same specialty or field.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making or filing a false report, or failing to file a record or report as required by law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making or filing a report which the licensee or applicant knows to be false or failing to file a record or report as required by law or regulation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report in writing within 30 days any disciplinary action taken against the licensee by another jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any disciplinary action taken against the licensee or applicant by another state, the Federal Government or a foreign country

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to report in writing within 30 days any criminal action or conviction against the licensee
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by a licensee or applicant to report in writing, within 30 days, any criminal action taken or conviction obtained against the licensee or applicant, other than a minor traffic violation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a medical facility when its license is suspended or revoked
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility at any time during which: (1) The license of the facility is suspended or revoked

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct per board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in any act that is unsafe or unprofessional conduct in accordance with regulations adopted by the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering an unapproved controlled substance or dangerous drug
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly or willfully procuring or administering a controlled substance or a dangerous drug as defined in chapter 454 of NRS that is not approved by the United States Food and Drug Administration

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to adequately supervise a medical assistant pursuant to board regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to supervise adequately a medical assistant pursuant to the regulations of the Board.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or ability to practice medicine
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony relating to the practice of medicine or the ability to practice medicine.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any disciplinary action or surrender of license in another jurisdiction, including while under investigation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any disciplinary action, including, without limitation, the revocation, suspension, modification or limitation of a license to practice any type of medicine, taken by another state, the Federal Government, a foreign country or any other jurisdiction or the surrender of the license or discontinuing the practice of medicine while under investigation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice, which may be evidenced by claims settled against a practitioner, but only if the malpractice is established by a preponderance of the evidence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in sexual activity with a patient currently being treated by the practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The engaging by a practitioner in any sexual activity with a patient who is currently being treated by the practitioner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, or others that interferes with patient care
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Disruptive behavior with physicians, hospital personnel, patients, members of the families of patients or any other persons if the behavior interferes with patient care or has an adverse impact on the quality of care rendered to a patient.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining, or renewing a license by bribery, fraud, misrepresentation, or false statement
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining or renewing or attempting to obtain, maintain or renew a license to practice medicine by bribery, fraud or misrepresentation or by any false, misleading, inaccurate or incomplete statement.

definition_quote.value: An anesthesiologist assistant means a person who has been issued a license by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.2683 or 630.2685, as applicable, and is approved by the Board to assist in the practice of medicine under the supervision of a supervising anesthesiologist.
definition_quote.quote: "Anesthesiologist assistant" means a person who has been issued a license by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.2683 or 630.2685, as applicable, and is approved by the Board to assist in the practice of medicine under the supervision of a supervising anesthesiologist.

methods_authorized.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant licensed under the provisions of this chapter may assist in the practice of medicine in accordance with the regulations adopted by the Board pursuant to NRS 630.26825 and under the supervision of a supervising anesthesiologist.

drug_authority.value: An anesthesiologist assistant may possess and administer preoperative and perioperative medications including controlled substances subject to the limitations of NRS 453.375, but shall not prescribe any controlled substance or any dangerous drug.
drug_authority.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant shall not prescribe any controlled substance or any dangerous drug, as defined in NRS 454.201.

supervising_anesthesiologist_physical_pr.quote: A supervising anesthesiologist shall be immediately available in such proximity to an anesthesiologist assistant during the performance of his or her duties that the supervising anesthesiologist is able to effectively reestablish direct contact with the patient to meet the medical needs of the patient and intervene to address any urgent or emergent clinical problems.

prescribing_authority.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant shall not prescribe any controlled substance or any dangerous drug, as defined in NRS 454.201.

value: Developing and implementing an anesthesia care plan for a patient
Obtaining the comprehensive health history of a patient and performing relevant elements of a physical examination
Ordering and performing preoperative and postoperative anesthetic patient evaluations and consultations
Possessing and administering preoperative and perioperative medications including controlled substances
Maintaining and altering levels of anesthesia and providing continuity of anesthetic care
Performing general anesthesia including induction, maintenance, emergence and related procedures
Administering vasoactive drugs and starting and titrating vasoactive infusions
Administering postoperative sedation, anxiolysis or analgesia medication
Entering medication chart orders as prescribed by the supervising anesthesiologist
Changing or discontinuing an anesthesia care plan after consulting the supervising anesthesiologist
Obtaining informed consent from a patient for anesthesia or related procedures
Pretesting and calibrating anesthesia delivery systems
Implementing medically accepted monitoring techniques
Establishing airway interventions and performing ventilatory support including endotracheal intubation and laryngeal mask insertion
Establishing peripheral intravenous lines and performing invasive procedures including arterial lines, central lines and Swan-Ganz catheters
Performing, maintaining, evaluating and managing epidural, spinal and regional anesthesia
Performing monitored anesthesia care
Conducting laboratory and other related studies including taking blood samples
Performing, ordering and interpreting preoperative, point-of-care, intraoperative or postoperative diagnostic testing
Monitoring the patient in the preoperative suite, recovery area or labor suites
Participating in administrative, research and clinical teaching activities including supervising student anesthesiologist assistants
Initiating and managing cardiopulmonary resuscitation in response to a life-threatening situation

supervising_anesthesiologist_qualificati.quote: "Supervising anesthesiologist" means an active physician who is licensed and in good standing in this State, is certified or is eligible to be certified as an anesthesiologist by the American Board of Anesthesiology or its successor organization and supervises one or more anesthesiologist assistants.

patient_disclosure_required.quote: An anesthesiologist assistant licensed pursuant to NRS 630.2683 or 630.2685 shall identify himself or herself as an anesthesiologist assistant when engaged in professional duties.
